00077 void UGenOutput::useExternalOutput(UGenOutput* externalOutputToUse)
00078 {
00079   if(externalOutputToUse == 0)
00080   {
00081     float value = 0.f;
00082     
00083     if(block)
00084       value = block[blockSize-1];
00085     
00086     usingExternalOutput = false;
00087     blockSize = UGen::getEstimatedBlockSize();
00088     allocatedBlockSize = blockSize;
00089     block = new float[blockSize];
00090     externalOutput = 0;
00091     
00092     initValue(value);
00093   }
00094   else
00095   {
00096     float value = 0.f;
00097     
00098     if(block)
00099       value = block[blockSize-1];
00100     
00101     if(usingExternalOutput == false)
00102       delete [] block;
00103     
00104     usingExternalOutput = true;
00105     block = externalOutputToUse->block;
00106     blockSize = externalOutputToUse->blockSize;
00107     allocatedBlockSize = 0;
00108     externalOutput = externalOutputToUse;
00109     
00110     initValue(value);
00111   }
00112 }

00236 float* UGenInternal::processBlockInternal(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00237 {
00238   if(blockID != lastBlockID)
00239   {
00240     processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00241     
00242     if(isScheduledForDeletion == false && shouldDelete == true)
00243     {
00244       isScheduledForDeletion = true;
00245       blockIDtoBeDeletedAfter = blockID;
00246     }
00247     
00248     lastBlockID = blockID;
00249   }
00250   
00251   return uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00252 }

00298 int UGenInternal::findMaxInputChannels() const throw()
00299 {
00300   int numChannels = 0;
00301   
00302   for(int i = 0; i < numInputs_; i++)
00303   {
00304     int inputChannels = inputs[i].getNumChannels();
00305     if(inputChannels > numChannels)
00306       numChannels = inputChannels;
00307   }
00308   
00309   return numChannels;
00310 }

00343     return 0.f;

00370 ProxyOwnerUGenInternal::ProxyOwnerUGenInternal(const int numInputs, const int numProxies) throw()
00371 : UGenInternal(numInputs),
00372   numProxies_(numProxies < 0 ? 0 : numProxies), // numProxies_ shouldn't be less than 0 but MixArray was sending -1 when its input was empty
00373   proxies(new UGenInternal*[numProxies_+1])
00374 {

00402 void ProxyOwnerUGenInternal::deleteIfOnlyMutualReferencesRemain() throw()
00403 {
00404   if(getRefCount() > numProxies_) return; 
00405   
00406   for(int i = 1 ; i <= numProxies_; i++)
00407   {
00408     if(proxies[i]->getRefCount() > 1) return;
00409   }
00410   
00411   for(int i = 1 ; i <= numProxies_; i++)
00412   {
00413     UGen::getDeleter()->deleteInternal(proxies[i]);
00414   }
00415   
00416   active = false;
00417   UGen::getDeleter()->deleteInternal(this);
00418 }
00419 
00420 UGenInternal* ProxyOwnerUGenInternal::getProxy(const int index) throw()
00421 {
00422   // indices are between 0 and numProxies_ (0 is the owner)
00423   if(index < 0 || index > numProxies_) 
00424   {
00425     ugen_assertfalse;
00426     return 0;
00427   }
00428   
00429   proxies[index]->incrementRefCount();
00430   return proxies[index];
00431 }

00433 void ProxyOwnerUGenInternal::prepareForBlockInternal(const int actualBlockSize, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00434 {
00435   ugen_assert(actualBlockSize > 0);
00436   
00437   if(blockID != lastBlockID)
00438   {
00439     UGenInternal::prepareForBlockInternal(actualBlockSize, blockID, channel);
00440     
00441     for(int i = 1; i <= numProxies_; i++)
00442     {
00443       // if the refCount is only 1 its block won't get 
00444       // prepared by the normal dsp call chain, check for <=1 just in case
00445       if(proxies[i]->getRefCount() <= 1)
00446         proxies[i]->prepareForBlockInternal(actualBlockSize, blockID, channel);
00447     } 
00448   }
00449 }
00450 
00451 
00452 float* ProxyOwnerUGenInternal::processBlockInternal(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00453 {
00454   if(blockID != lastBlockID)
00455   {
00456     for(int i = 1; i <= numProxies_; i++)
00457     {
00458       // if the refCount is only 1 its block won't get 
00459       // processed by the normal dsp call chain, check for <=1 just in case
00460       if(proxies[i]->getRefCount() <= 1)
00461         proxies[i]->processBlockInternal(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00462     }
00463 
00464     UGenInternal::processBlockInternal(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00465   }
00466   
00467   return uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00468 }
